card.name: Words before a year or century
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as by, in, or of that sit right before a date, such as a year, century or decade, in history and biography text. Also fires on words in a sentence that is about to give a time period.

modes.label: Linking word before a date
modes.description: A preposition like by, in, or of comes right before a year, month or century.

modes.label: Inside decade or period phrases
modes.description: A word or digit partway through a decade or period expression, or a phrase leading toward a time span.

card.writes: It suppresses month names and the era marker for years before the common era, so it steers the next word away from a month.
card.plain: It notices when a history sentence is about to name a year or century, and stops the model from guessing a month.
